title: Gatefold cell report
description: Machine-readable cell report emitted by gatefold report-cell or compare-cells --format json. Version 9 describes one yuurei cell — its trace and manifest records, the verified pre-run pfl export the observation record declares, the v0.8 audit facts, and an optional supplied evaluation — or a directional A -> B account of two compatible cells. Every entry names its evidence lane and carries a state and a completeness. This is a descriptive evidence report: no causal attribution, no ranking, and no new quality judgement.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this result schema. Additive changes keep the version; structural changes bump it.

inputs.description: Descriptors of the cell inputs: 'run' for report-cell, 'before'/'after' for compare-cells, and the optional supplied evaluation document.

entries.description: Every statement of the report in contract order: by subject (before before after), then lane (association, configuration, execution, audit, evaluation, comparison), then each lane's stable ordering.

cellInput.description: Descriptor of one cell input: the run directory plus the identities needed to reconcile the report.

label.description: The run directory argument as supplied.

cellId.description: trace.cell_id — the prepared cell instance id, or null when the trace does not record one. Not the same as run_id, requested_cell.digest, or the pfl snapshot ids.

requestedCellDigest.description: trace.requested_cell.digest — the requested input set, or null when the trace does not record it.

observationStatus.description: The trace's observation.status, or null when no observation record exists.

exportObservedSnapshotId.description: data.snapshot.observedSnapshotId of the bound export, or null when none was bound.

exportResolvedSnapshotId.description: data.snapshot.resolvedSnapshotId of the bound export, or null when none was bound.

evaluationInput.description: Descriptor of the optionally supplied gatefold evaluation result document.

label.description: The evaluation document argument as supplied.

schemaVersion.description: The supplied document's schemaVersion (6 or 7); 0 when it did not identify as one.

lane.description: The record family the entry reports: association (trace/export cross-checks), configuration (bound pfl export content), execution (yuurei run records), audit (v0.8 facts), evaluation (supplied context), comparison (A -> B statements).

subject.description: compare-cells only: which cell the entry describes; absent on comparison entries and in single-cell results.

id.description: Stable dot-separated entry identifier from docs/v0.9-scope.md (e.g. 'association.export-binding', 'configuration.element.<id>', 'comparison.element-added.<id>').

state.description: recorded: a document declares this (content restated, no independent check). verified: the records affirmatively establish the check. inconsistent: two well-formed records contradict each other. unverifiable: a needed record is missing, mismatched, truncated, or uninterpretable. not-recorded: the record the entry reports was never produced — absence reported as absence.

completeness.description: How complete the evidence behind the entry is — separate from state: a bound export declaring completeness 'partial' yields 'partial' entries; an unverifiable or absent record is 'unknown'.

statement.description: A descriptive account of what the record declares or what the check established — never a causal claim or a judgement.

evidence.description: References into the named inputs that support the entry; every pointer resolves inside its document.

source.description: Which named input the reference resolves against. Bare names are the single cell's documents; before*/after* names are the A and B sides' documents. 'export' is the digest-verified pfl export artifact declared by the run's observation record; 'evaluation' is the supplied evaluation document.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) into the document named by source. For patch/result it is the artifact's manifest pointer (/artifacts/<i>) with path/lines/bytes locating inside verified bytes; for manifest it names the manifest entry. The empty string references the whole document.

digest.description: Verified-byte evidence only: the manifest-recorded digest of the stored bytes the reference locates into — for 'export' it binds the citation to the retained artifact bytes.

path.description: Patch evidence only: the workspace-relative file path whose block the range locates inside the stored patch bytes.

lines.description: Artifact evidence only: an inclusive 1-based line range inside the verified stored bytes.

bytes.description: Artifact evidence only: an inclusive 0-based byte range inside the verified stored bytes.

elementId.description: Export evidence only: the pfl element id the reference is about.

note.description: A short clarifier, e.g. naming an absent field when the pointer references a document root.

transform.description: The build path that produced the entry, e.g. ['report-cell', 'entry:association.export-binding'] or ['compare-cells', 'audit-run', 'fact:patch.stored'].
